description: Fork of exp650 (single final residual_lut, E=384 = 1.4825 @ 86.51M). Single change: enable sparse_scatter on out_proj at 1/2 sparsity. Each table now has per-table n_outputs=192 (instead of E=384) and scatter-adds into the wider E=384 final output. Halves out_proj weights: per layer 1*256*64*384 -> 1*256*64*192 = 3,145,728 (-3.15M/layer, -18.87M total). Expected total params ~67.64M. Tests the new hybrid_smooth+sparse_scatter path on out_proj. Reference: exp650 = 1.4825 (E=384, dense out_proj), exp651 = 1.4813 (E=384, per-layer resid), exp648 = 1.4827 (E=192, per-layer resid), vanilla SOTA exp328 = 1.3882.
